headline: Detroit rapper SkillaBaby is opening up about the darker side of his personal experiences
body: Detroit rapper SkillaBaby is opening up about the darker side of his personal experiences and how repeated trauma shaped the person he became. In a revealing interview, Skilla Baby explained that being sh*t multiple times in a assassination attempt that changed his outlook on life, admitting that he became more “evil” after experiencing situations that left him hurt, angry, and emotionally affected.

source_caption_text:
Detroit rapper #SkillaBaby is opening up about the darker side of his personal experiences and how repeated trauma shaped the person he became.

In a revealing interview, Skilla Baby explained that being sh*t multiple times in a assassination attempt that changed his outlook on life, admitting that he became more “evil” after experiencing situations that left him hurt, angry, and emotionally affected.

He reflected on how his pain influenced the way he viewed the world, sharing that at one point, he wanted other people to experience the same feelings he had been forced to endure.

“I wanted to make someone feel like how I felt.”

Can you blame him?
